fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the street.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges so emergency vehicles can pass through without restriction.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure to reduce the distance responders must work through to reach exterior walls.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings without pushing through heavy growth.
• Thin dense vegetation areas adjacent to structures so responders can move around the buildings and stage equipment on all accessible sides.
• Mark or label the detached structure visibly from the driveway so arriving responders immediately identify it as a separate building on the property.
• Keep the open lawn area free of stored materials or equipment so responders can use it as a staging area for vehicles and personnel.
• Because only one driveway access point serves the property, maintain that entrance at full width and keep it free of gates, overgrown shrubs, or parked vehicles at all times.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters nearest to the structure to create open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove or trim shrubs and low plants growing directly against the exterior walls of the structure.
• Separate the scattered trees from each other and from the structure by removing the smaller or more crowded trees between them.
• Trim the lower branches of large trees near the structure so branches do not extend close to the roofline or walls.
• Clear ground vegetation growing beneath and between trees that surround the structure.
• Create visible open ground between the base of trees and the structure on all sides.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along its full length.
• Remove dead or dry ground vegetation along both sides of the driveway or access route.
• Thin vegetation on both sides of the access route so emergency vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Pull back shrubs and ground cover from the edges of the access route to keep the travel surface and shoulders clear.
• Work around all sides of the structure to open up space where vegetation is growing closest to the building.
